Hello All who enter this Sub! As a self published author, I felt that the platform for those of us that write was absent from VOAT. A certain other website had a self published sub, but it wasn't exactly active. Whether or not this sub becomes active is up to all of you that visit!

If you're a writer, feel free to post your stuff! Advertise your Amazon publisher link or any other page that contains your work. If your work is NSFW, please mark it as such, but FEEL FREE TO POST IT!!

This is a great idea for a sub. Thanks for making it. As a self published author who doesn't really have the money for advertising, I need way more ways like this to draw attention to my work and get the word out there. I hope it also becomes a place of learning as well as just a place for people to peddle their wares though.

Absolutely! Like I said, I haven't exactly mapped out the idea for the sub, but I have several ideas. I agree that this should/could be so much more than just "Hey buy this book I wrote". I want this to become a community of unknown to little known authors eager and willing to participate in discussion and help each other. I love the idea of making this a learning sub as well. I will do what I can to share pages for beginning authors as well as any other informational/entertaining items I find that have anything to do with being an Author. As it is right now, I know this sub is a little plain, and REALLY needs some better explanations as to what the intention is. I will work on that first chance I get. If you have any ideas please feel free to let me know.

I'll contribute when I think of something worth contributing (outside of my books of course). Let me know if there's anything I can do to help too. I'd like to help make something like this a great resource for self published authors.

Contribute anything you feel fits the theme here. Self-promotion isn't bad, as long as it isn't spammy. Promotion of other's works is also a good start, so long as they are OK with your promotion (or if they haven't openly said not to) and you give credit. Again, once I get home and am able to do so, I will edit the side bar with some more info and maybe some rules or suggestions.

Cool sub. Glad to have seen it and glad you put it up here.
